categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the development, production, and sales of electronic measurement instruments including digital oscilloscopes, RF instruments, waveform generators, power supplies and electronic loads, multimeters, and data acquisition devices. It also provides related technical and after-sales services, software and hardware sales, and import-export business. The business covers chip-level, module-level, and system-level solutions for various industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include proprietary high-bandwidth, high-resolution digital oscilloscope platforms ('Fairy', 'Phoenix', 'Centaur'), high-speed ADC and signal processing chips, low-noise analog front-end designs, and advanced algorithms for data acquisition and waveform analysis. The company employs integrated product development (IPD) processes, lean manufacturing, and automation including semi-automated packaging and testing lines. It maintains in-house production for core components and outsources non-critical parts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves customers in over 90 countries, targeting industries such as communications, new energy, semiconductors, consumer electronics, industrial electronics, transportation, education, and scientific research. Key markets include China, North America, Europe, Japan, and emerging markets in Asia and South America. Customers range from research institutions and universities to large enterprises and system integrators.
categories.geographic_coverage: Headquartered in Suzhou, China, with R&D centers in Beijing, Shanghai, and Xi'an, and overseas subsidiaries in the USA, Germany, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, Malaysia, and sales offices in India, Brazil, Vietnam, among others. The company has a global footprint with localized marketing, technical support, and service teams.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on R&D, manufacturing, assembly, and sales of electronic measurement instruments. It manages procurement of raw materials and components, production, and distribution, maintaining strategic supplier relationships and a lean, flexible global supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include original technology innovation with a 'technology + market' dual-drive approach, focusing on integrated circuit design, composite material processes, advanced manufacturing, and software/hardware algorithm development. R&D targets high-bandwidth digital oscilloscopes, high-resolution instruments, RF/microwave technologies, modular instruments, and platform software. The company emphasizes domestic substitution and international competitiveness, investing heavily in patent development and talent cultivation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of electronic measurement instruments and related accessories. The company uses a mixed sales model combining distributor (buyout) channels and direct sales including e-commerce platforms. It also earns income from after-sales services, technical support, and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks fifth globally in the oscilloscope market and is the only Chinese company in the top five. It holds a leading domestic position in digital oscilloscopes, waveform generators, and RF instruments, competing with established international players from the USA, Germany, and Japan. It is recognized for its core technology innovation and patent portfolio, positioning itself as a technology leader in China's electronic measurement industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 670.5 million, a 6.34% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 107.95 million, up 16.72%. R&D investment accounted for 21.3% of revenue. Total assets reached RMB 3.27 billion, growing 17.09% from the previous year. The company has shown steady growth with improving gross margins and expanding market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes original technology innovation, high performance, and cost-effective solutions with proprietary core technologies such as high-bandwidth analog front-end chips and advanced digital signal processing. Its products offer superior bandwidth, resolution, sampling rates, and waveform capture capabilities, meeting demanding applications in communications, semiconductors, and new energy sectors. The company also provides comprehensive multi-level solutions and localized global support, enabling customers to overcome complex testing challenges and accelerate technological innovation.
